{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING 401 STORM IN services/auth/token_refresh.py — FIVE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

All incidents manifested as a burst of unauthorized responses in the access log during token refresh operations, reproducible by letting an access token expire mid-session. Each occurred in the authentication side of services/auth/token_refresh.py and was resolved independently.

INCIDENT 1 — [2026-01-06]
Scope: clients pinned to v1 SDK only
Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
Measured outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 86 days running
Fix: made default empty and built value per call
PR #4371, branch fix/401-storm-1

INCIDENT 2 — [2026-03-10]
Scope: first request after cold start only
Root cause: error swallowed by bare except clause
Measured outcome: throughput rose 85%, to 265 requests per second
Fix: narrowed exception handler and let failure propagate
PR #4730, branch fix/401-storm-2

INCIDENT 3 — [2026-03-14]
Scope: sessions arriving through OAuth provider only
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Measured outcome: p99 latency fell from 7.3 s to 150 ms
Fix: raised pool ceiling and added bounded wait queue in front
PR #5027, branch fix/401-storm-3

INCIDENT 4 — [2026-04-26]
Scope: staging read replica only
Root cause: listener registered on initialization but never removed on teardown
Measured outcome: reclaimed 96 GB of blob storage
Fix: removed listener on teardown and asserted in test
PR #6236, branch fix/401-storm-5

INCIDENT 5 — [2026-05-17]
Scope: when input list came in empty only
Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
Measured outcome: backlog cleared 60 minutes after deploy
Fix: prefetched relation in single query
PR #8330, branch fix/401-storm-6"}
